name: ponpoko-surface-agents-kanban
description: A drag-and-drop kanban board where coding agents pull cards, hand them to another agent for testing, and the board keeps the session of every card alive.

scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.backend.json --noEmit
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bunx vite build && bun scripts/bundle.mjs
